Subject: Zelvane Inns Submission - Referral Required

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the Zelvane Inns submission. I've reviewed the information and have everything I need from a documentation standpoint.

However, this risk requires referral to senior underwriting before I can provide a quote. Here's why:

- Hospitality risks need additional review at our level
- The five-year loss history exceeds $250K, which triggers our referral threshold

I'd like to present this to my manager, but given the loss activity, it may ultimately fall outside our appetite. If we're unable to move forward, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty hospitality market, one that focus on this class.

I'll follow up early next week after discussing internally.

Best regards,  
[Underwriter name]
